slides.title: Interaction rates
slides.body: They matter more than raw views or likes.

slides.title: Timing
slides.tip: Post when fans are online: kick-off, half-time, full-time.

slides.title: Originality
slides.body: Original content is prioritised over reposts.
slides.tip: Training, tunnel and dressing-room footage should weigh more than rebroadcast clips.

slides.body: Small accounts can be shown to non-followers.
slides.tip: Use Trial Reels to test formats without risking your main feed.

slides.body: What works one week may not work the next.
